derivation:
by
  intro f g h; apply WithConv.ext; apply (AlgHom.cancel_left hψ).mp
  simpa only [postComp, WithConv.toConv_injective.eq_iff] using h
explanation: AlgHom.cancel_left gives cancellation of postcomposition by an injective algebra homomorphism. Apply it to the underlying algebra homomorphisms, removing the WithConv wrappers.
